definitions.explanation: A government official who handles administrative and clerical duties, as opposed to technical or specialized officers. A formal title used in Japan's civil service system.

examples.japanese: {裁判所|さいばんしょ}{事務官|じむかん}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work as a court clerk.

examples.japanese: {事務官|じむかん}の{採用|さいよう}{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I passed the administrative officer recruitment exam.

examples.japanese: {外務省|がいむしょう}の{事務官|じむかん}は{国際的|こくさいてき}な{業務|ぎょうむ}にも{携|たずさ}わる。
examples.english: Administrative officials at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are also involved in international affairs.

notes: In the Japanese civil service, {事務官|じむかん} is contrasted with {技官|ぎかん} (technical officer). Common compound terms: {裁判所|さいばんしょ}{事務官|じむかん} (court clerk), {検察|けんさつ}{事務官|じむかん} (prosecution clerk), {外務|がいむ}{事務官|じむかん} (foreign affairs administrative officer). The title indicates a general administrative role within a government ministry or agency. Compare with {事務員|じむいん} (office worker — used for private sector), {官僚|かんりょう} (bureaucrat — higher-ranking).
